assets.initialPrompt:
Use case: compositing. Asset: premium professional product-in-use editorial photograph, landscape 16:9 composition, 1920x1080. Input image 1 is the cleaned unbranded AP3150 product cutout to integrate faithfully. Input image 2 is its original photograph solely as geometry reference; DO NOT copy its branding.
Build a realistic content-creator tabletop video setup around ONE actual AP3150 light. Close three-quarter rear view of a compact unbranded mirrorless camera on a small tabletop tripod, with the AP3150 mounted horizontally above it on a tiny cold-shoe adapter, photographing one sculptural cream ceramic object on a light grey table. A content creator's natural hand gently adjusts the camera from the right; softly blurred neutral home studio, daylight window, restrained premium white/grey/black palette.
The AP3150 is the clear hero in the centre-left and its rear face fills roughly 30% of image width, in sharp focus together with the camera. Camera body should be about the same width as the light: actual light is 151mm wide,79mm high,11mm thin. Show its REAR face essentially straight on with only subtle perspective so that the exact source product is recognizable. INVARIANTS: flat smooth grey wide 1.9:1 rounded rectangular plate, thin black perimeter rim, no ribbing, little black rectangular screen near upper right, original right-edge functional controls in original positions, rainbow colour scale at lower left, tiny functional USB port labels at lower right. Preserve its proportions, texture, construction and exact original silhouette. Screen may remain dark. Its white-light-emitting front faces AWAY from us toward the ceramic object. Natural shadow and physical mount, never floating.
No duplicated light, no second panel, no grille/ribs/diffuser on the visible rear, no redesign or generic light. No branding, logo, product name, camera brand, watermark, packaging, orange/blue boxes, overlaid captions or other text. Photographic commercial craft, realistic shallow depth of field, refined neutral grading, subtle daylight, uncluttered balanced frame. This is a photograph of the specific supplied hardware in use, not a CGI illustration.

assets.initialPrompt:
Use case: compositing. Asset: premium professional interview behind-the-scenes photograph, landscape 16:9, 1920x1080. Input 1 is a cleaned AP336 reference with FRONT above and REAR below of the SAME product. Input 2 is the original geometry reference. They are alternative views, NOT two physical lights. Use ONLY the top FRONT view as the visible surface of ONE physical AP336 on-camera LED panel.
Make a professional interview filming scene in an elegant daylight studio. View from slightly beside the interview guest looking toward the compact unbranded video camera and operator. One real AP336 light is mounted horizontally on a short camera cold-shoe/ball adapter above the camera, facing the guest and us. The light's FRONT and discrete LEDs are prominent, sharp and recognizable, occupying about 30% of the entire frame width near centre-left. Camera lens directly below faces the same direction as light. A seated interview guest is a softly blurred shoulder/profile on the right foreground and a professional camera operator is softly blurred behind the camera left, with believable natural anatomy. Neutral light-grey, black and warm-white set, restrained daylight, no visual clutter.
Exact hardware invariants: AP336 155×90×24mm, broad horizontal black rectangular frame with original rounded corners, original dense 24 columns by14 rows =336 evenly spaced separate little square LEDs in alternating pale yellow/white columns, behind a clear cover in a blue-grey inset PCB. Preserve the reference's aspect ratio, black border thickness, all LED grid alignment and physical texture; it is NOT a soft white diffuser. Keep light approximately same width as camera body, not giant. LEDs give gentle fill light but remain individually visible and not blown out; do not turn them into huge circles, rings, strips, or a solid white face. Rear/battery details should stay hidden, so do not invent a battery shape or duplicate the rear view.
No branding, logos, model name, watermark, packaging, orange/blue boxes, extra light panel, overlaid words or captions. Natural commercially photographed materials, physically convincing camera mount, premium editorial photography and balanced 16:9 frame. Do not redesign the hardware or create generic CGI devices.
assets.rejectionReason: Front LED row count differed from source; replaced with faithful rear-facing composition.
